body.text: The journey from hospital discharge to your own front door is often the most tiring day of a medical trip. At [Itinerary of Türkiye](https://itineraryofturkiye.com/about), our two founders run an independent, client-paid, flat-fee advisory—paid by our clients and independent of provider commissions—so we design return transit around physical comfort, low walking distances, and realistic recovery margins. We coordinate your visit. Your licensed medical team makes clinical decisions.
Which prescribed medications must stay in carry-on with doctor letters?

Never pack essential post-operative medications in checked luggage, where delayed bags or cargo temperature swings can disrupt your treatment schedule. Keep antibiotics, painkillers, anti-inflammatory tablets, anti-nausea drugs, blood-thinning injections, and sterile eye or nasal drops in your cabin bag in original pharmacy packaging accompanied by a signed English prescription and doctor's letter.

Security checkpoints at Istanbul Airport and arrival customs in your home country can question unlabeled pillboxes, liquids over 100 ml, or pre-filled anticoagulant syringes. Review the [Turkish Consulate General guidance on carrying medication](https://losangeles-cg.mfa.gov.tr/Mission/ShowInfoNote/410626) and your airline's medical rules before departure, and confirm whether your carrier requires formal [UK Civil Aviation Authority medical clearance](https://www.caa.co.uk/air-passengers/about-your-trip/health-and-medical/getting-medical-clearance-to-fly/) after recent surgery.

items: Carry-on document folder: Signed fit-to-fly certificate, discharge summary, and itemized medication letter stating generic drug names and doses.
Original boxes: Keep blister packs inside labelled boxes with your full passport name printed on the prescription.
Injectables and liquids: Pack pre-filled blood-thinner syringes and saline sprays in a clear zip bag for quick X-ray screening.
Buffer supply: Bring at least 48 hours of extra prescribed doses in case of weather or airline delays.

body.text: How do compression stockings, hydration and cabin walks protect recovery?

Recent surgery and prolonged sitting on flights lasting four hours or more both raise the risk of deep vein thrombosis (DVT) and lower-limb swelling. Wearing properly fitted graduated compression stockings, drinking plain water consistently, and standing up for short aisle walks help maintain venous blood flow and limit fluid pooling.

Both the [NHS post-surgery guidance](https://www.nhs.uk/tests-and-treatments/having-surgery/afterwards/) and [NHS 111 Wales travel health advice](https://111.wales.nhs.uk/travelhealth/traveltips/) note that below-knee compression stockings reduce DVT risk and leg swelling on flights of four hours or longer. The [CDC Yellow Book guidance on DVT](https://www.cdc.gov/yellow-book/hcp/travel-air-sea/deep-vein-thrombosis-and-pulmonary-embolism.html) similarly advises at-risk travellers to use clinician-fitted stockings, perform seated calf-pump exercises, and avoid alcohol or sedating sleeping pills that keep you motionless. Always ask your surgeon whether you also require prescribed anticoagulant cover before boarding.
Why is direct-flight booking worth the extra fare after surgery?

A nonstop flight eliminates extra takeoff-and-landing pressure cycles, tight gate sprints, secondary security screening, and hours sitting upright in unfamiliar transit terminals. For post-operative travellers, paying €100 to €250 more for a direct route from Istanbul typically cuts total door-to-door fatigue in half and lowers the risk of missing a medication window.

Under [UK Civil Aviation Authority guidance on surgical conditions](https://www.caa.co.uk/air-passengers/about-your-trip/health-and-medical/guidance-for-health-professionals/surgical-conditions/), cabin altitude expands trapped gas and adds physiological stress after abdominal, chest, or facial procedures. Fewer flight segments also mean fewer luggage transfers and less chance of being stranded overnight without your recovery supplies. If your home city has no nonstop flight from Istanbul, break the trip with an airport-connected hotel or request airline wheelchair assistance in advance.
What airport transfer vehicle upgrades reduce bumps and fatigue?

Standard city taxis in Istanbul vary widely in suspension quality, legroom, and luggage space, which matters immediately after abdominal, body, or facial surgery. Upgrading to a licensed private Mercedes V-Class or Sprinter-class VIP van with reclining seats, step assistance, and calm driving minimizes road vibration and avoids awkward climbs into high or cramped cabins.

faq.q: How soon after surgery is it safe to fly home from Türkiye?
faq.a: Safe flying timelines vary widely by procedure—from roughly 5 to 7 days after minor facial work to 10 days or more after major abdominal or chest surgery. Only your operating surgeon can sign your fit-to-fly clearance.

faq.q: Can I bring ice packs through Istanbul Airport security for facial swelling?
faq.a: Gel ice packs are usually treated as liquids or gels and restricted above 100 ml unless medically exempted with documentation. Empty zip-lock bags that cabin crew can fill with ice on board are a simpler backup.

faq.q: Should I book an aisle seat or a window seat after surgery?
faq.a: An aisle seat is usually better because it lets you stand and walk every hour without climbing over other passengers. The exception is after facial or ear surgery if you need a bulkhead or extra-legroom aisle seat away from cart traffic.

faq.q: Will airport security ask me to remove surgical bandages or compression garments?
faq.a: Security officers may perform a pat-down or private screening if dressings or metal staples trigger scanners. Carry your English surgical discharge letter to explain garments and dressings calmly without removing sterile wraps.

faq.q: Can I request airport wheelchair assistance even if I can walk short distances?
faq.a: Yes. Istanbul Airport is one of the largest terminals in the world, and walking to remote gates can exceed 1.5 kilometers. Pre-booking airline mobility assistance conserves energy and prevents post-operative exhaustion.

faq.q: Does Itinerary of Türkiye supply post-op medications or medical clearances?
faq.a: No. Your licensed hospital pharmacy dispenses medications and your surgeon issues all medical clearances. We coordinate your private transfers, airport escorts, and recovery-friendly flight logistics.
